$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the care pack composed with a general and family dentistry content seed, re-registered in the bubblegum register (glossy Y2K candy pop) with its own pinned page skeletons. Everything else — pages' builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Dental Office
description: A dental office's site with real online booking: Bright Side Dental on Wilshire in Koreatown, art-directed as glossy Y2K candy pop — bubblegum pink, mint, and cherry red, inflated display type (a real web font, never images of text), sticker badges and glossy pills. The hero: "Smile more. Dread less." beside a photograph with a heart roundel and three stickers (Open Saturdays, Kids love it here, Most insurance), then pill cards for cleanings, clear aligners, and same-day emergencies, printed self-pay prices, in-network PPO plans named as text (never logos), a clear-aligner story, two dentists and a hygienist with portraits, patient reviews, an FAQ, and a booking page offering new-patient visits (90 min), cleanings (60), and emergency visits (30). The booking form is clinically empty — name, contact, visit type, new/returning. Stylish, not childish.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so these practice and appointments seeds replace the base pack's at compose and mirror THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twins) — the composed template's Manage editors and booking widget open on the dental practice, not the base clinic.

providers.name: Dr. Grace Yoon
providers.bio: Grace opened Bright Side in 2019 because she was tired of dental offices that felt like waiting for bad news. She sees kids from their first tooth and grown-ups who haven't been in a decade — no lectures. She speaks Korean and English.

providers.name: Dr. Mateo Ortiz
providers.bio: Mateo does the office's clear aligner cases, whitening, and bonding, and he's the one to see if a chipped tooth ruined your weekend. He explains every step before he takes it, in English or Spanish.

providers.name: Joy Santos
providers.bio: Joy runs cleanings like a spa appointment with better lighting. Headphones, a warm blanket, a thumbs-up system for breaks — and a gift for getting kids to open wide on the first try.

services.name: Cleanings & checkups
services.description: A gentle cleaning, a real look, and x-rays only when you need them. Most visits take under an hour, with breaks whenever you want one.

services.name: Clear aligners
services.description: Straighter teeth without metal brackets. A scan, a plan you can see before you start, and check-ins every six to eight weeks.

services.name: Emergency same-day
services.description: A broken tooth, a swollen jaw, a lost filling. Call before noon and we'll see you today — Saturdays included.

services.name: Kids' dentistry
services.description: First visits from the first tooth. Sealants, fluoride, and a treasure box at the end, with parents welcome in the room.

services.name: Fillings & crowns
services.description: Tooth-colored fillings and same-week crowns, with numbing that actually works and a plan printed before we start.

services.name: Whitening & bonding
services.description: In-office whitening in one visit or take-home trays. Bonding for chips and gaps that bug you in photos.

services.name: Care for nervous patients
services.description: Tell us it's hard for you. Longer appointments, a stop signal we always honor, and laughing gas when it helps.

locations.label: Wilshire & Western
locations.address: 3700 Wilshire Boulevard, Suite 210, Los Angeles, CA 90010

reviews.quote: My daughter asked when she gets to go back. To the DENTIST. Joy is a wizard.
reviews.name: Hannah L.

reviews.quote: I hadn't been in eight years because I was embarrassed. Dr. Yoon didn't lecture me once. We made a plan, and I actually finished it.
reviews.name: Marcus T.

reviews.quote: Cracked a molar on a Saturday morning and was in the chair by eleven. The waiting room is extremely pink and I'm here for it.
reviews.name: Priya S.

reviews.quote: Dr. Ortiz showed me what my teeth would look like before I paid a cent. Nine months later they look exactly like that.
reviews.name: Daniel K.

newPatient.title: Book online
newPatient.body: Pick a new-patient visit and a time. We'll check your insurance before you arrive and tell you your share in writing.

newPatient.title: Paperwork in five minutes
newPatient.body: Arrive ten minutes early and fill in your forms on a tablet at the front desk — no clipboard, and nothing health-related goes through the website.

newPatient.title: Your first visit
newPatient.body: About 90 minutes: x-rays if you need them, an exam, a cleaning, and a printed plan with every price on it.

newPatient.title: Kids' first visit
newPatient.body: Short, fun, and mostly about meeting the chair. Parents stay in the room. We see kids from their first tooth.

types.name: New patient visit
types.description: Exam, x-rays if needed, a cleaning, and your plan.

types.name: Cleaning & checkup
types.description: Your regular cleaning and a quick look from the dentist.

types.name: Emergency visit
types.description: Same-day for a broken tooth, a lost filling, or swelling.

theme.$comment: The bubblegum register in its own hot pink: mode light opens the site in its native appearance (the bubblegum ground); dark is the candy shop after close. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-inks pages and app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared careShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop): care-direct wears the full-width sign band, care-therapy-duet the centered masthead, and care-psychology-studio the split letterhead — so the dental office takes the pill cluster, candy on a string.

landing.$comment: A pinned layout (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): style re-registers the base's pages in the bubblegum register, and pages carries exactly the skeletons careLanding.ts emits from this remix's contentSeed — the content-gated sections (promises, menu, spotlight, faq) appear because the seed fills them — so the composed template's document reproduces its code config section for section (tests/View/Care/careLanding.test.ts reads this through composedLandingSeed).
